h2.strong: How to change webhook securisation token?

ul.li: Go to settings in debug mode.
Edit the Channex webhook header with the new token value.

div.class: o_editor_banner user-select-none lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-warning pb-0 pt-3 o-contenteditable-false

div.p:
During the time tokens are not aligned between Odoo and Channex, no booking can be acknowledged.
In such situation, Channex will send the booking again to a maximum of 30 minutes.
Make sure to align token on both side prior the end of this period to avoid missing any booking.
